dataset.name: DROID subset distributed with the Ctrl-World checkout

selection_policy: Episode 1799 was excluded from the three-context development atlas and frozen before accept probe execution. The replay start, seeds, checkpoint, probe definitions, radii, outcome weights, and locality threshold are inherited without accept-side tuning.
claim_boundary: This is an independently frozen directional-selector accept context. It does not turn base intervention doses into repair-effect evidence.
